title: Update your financial model after earnings
surface: Cowork + Claude for Excel + Claude for PowerPoint
description: Cowork pulls the release and transcript from S&P and checks them against your financial model. You take the flags into Claude for Excel to edit the cells, then open the deck in Claude for PowerPoint to build the page.
prompt: ACME just jumped 8% after hours — what's driving this? I need to update my model and build a page for tomorrow's PM meeting.
steps: Pull the earnings release and call transcript from S&P
Read your model in the folder and flag forecast discrepancies
Identify unsupported assumptions from the transcript
Provide a brief with cell references and recommended changes
prerequisites: Portfolio folder with financial model attached
notes: Page also shows a second prompt to paste into Claude for Excel: "Q4 print: rev $2.72B (beat), GM 45.7% vs my 42.4%. Flag on Assumptions!C7 — FY28E GM at 43.0%, mgmt didn't guide past FY27. Walk me through C7, then build best/base/worst scenarios on the margin range."
